findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "human_request_quote" is 812 chars, far longer than this server's median (140). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: human_list_services, human_request_quote, human_get_job · Private data: human_list_evidence · Public sink: human_request_quote, human_reply_to_job.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: human_list_services, human_request_quote, human_get_job · Private data: human_list_evidence · Public sink: human_request_quote, human_reply_to_job

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
